questions.stem: A water tank fills at a constant rate. Which type of graph best represents the volume of water against time?

options.text: A straight line with positive gradient
A straight line with negative gradient

questions.explanation: A constant fill rate means the volume increases at the same rate over time, producing a straight line with a positive gradient.

questions.stem: On a distance-time graph, a horizontal section represents:
questions.explanation: A horizontal line on a distance-time graph means the distance is not changing, so the object is stationary (not moving).
